item.title: Let's Walk!! Garret Mountain — Sat Oct 10, 9:30 AM
item.description:
Let's Walk!! Join me for the paved loop at Garret Mountain Reservation.
We will meet at the parking lot on the loop, turn right on Park Ave from Mountain Ave, lot is on the left. GPS Address for Garrett is 8 Mountain Ave Woodland Park.
Garret Mountain Reservation, located in both Woodland Park and Paterson, is one of Passaic County’s most frequented parks. The original landscape was designed by the famed Olmsted Brothers Firm. The 310 acres of recreational space sits more than 500 feet above sea level, with scenic views of Paterson and the New York City skyline. Lambert Castle and Lambert Tower, two of Passaic County’s historic sites, are also located within Garret Mountain Reservation.
Rain or extreme weather will cancel the event.
Collaborative walk with "Montclair Women Over 50."
Disclaimer: If you join us for a hike, please understand that you are responsible for your own preparedness and well-being and will hold no one else liable in case of injury or mishap.
Source: Meetup:

item.title: Olmsted Historic Walking Tour of Anderson Park — Sat Oct 10, 10:00 AM — Anderson Park
item.description:
Before Anderson Park existed, three houses and a fire station sat on the park property. Discover where they went and other surprising stories about how this Olmsted-designed Essex County park came to be created 120 years ago, how it shaped Upper Montclair, and how it led to the formation of other Montclair parks. On this illustrated tour, also learn about efforts to rejuvenate the landscape of this park, on the National Register of Historic Places. Handicap accessible. Meet in Anderson Park at the boulder at the park’s northeast entrance. Tour is from 10 a.m. to 11:30 a.m. Free. Call or check the Friends of Anderson Park Facebook page for weather updates.
